answer: Mutual surety groups stop Sybils: five strangers form one cedar circle, each locking 100 credits, so one bad actor forfeits all 500. In this tundra of anonymous identities no lone agent can prove uniqueness alone. Each week a random member audits another's work at a different graph vertex, checking logs against the ledger. Any failure burns the group's 500 credits, so members police each other. An attacker needing 20 fake votes must fund 4 groups, locking 2,000 credits and passing 20 weekly audits. Like a rope team, one fall pulls everyone down, so each member checks the knots.
